import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

try:
    import lightgbm as lgb
    from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
    from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
except ImportError as e:
    print(f"Import error: {e}")
    exit(1)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Feature selection
# Columns to exclude from training: id, target
exclude_cols = ["id", "target"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]
n_test = len(test_df)
n_train = len(train_df)

# Preprocessing
# f_27 is categorical object, convert to category codes for LightGBM
# Ensure this is done on the full training set before split to maintain consistency
train_df["f_27"] = train_df["f_27"].astype("category")
test_df["f_27"] = test_df["f_27"].astype("category")

X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train = train_df["target"].values

X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Hold-out validation split (80/20)
# Stratify to maintain class distribution in validation set
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Prepare LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Model parameters optimized for tabular data - reduced for faster training
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,  # Increased learning rate for faster convergence
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model with reduced boosting rounds to fit within time limit
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,  # Reduced from 2000 to 500
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file
submission_dir = "submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_pred})
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")

# Print final metric
print(f"\nFinal Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc}")
